nodes.statement: A common positive asymptotic semigroup-decay exponent on a linear class dense in Omega-perp is equivalent, after reconstruction, to the corresponding non-vacuum spectral lower bound.

Construct one four-dimensional limiting gauge-invariant hierarchy satisfying the complete Osterwalder-Schrader/reconstruction hypotheses and identify its Hilbert space, vacuum, and nonnegative self-adjoint Hamiltonian.
For the same reconstructed limiting theory, prove that the centered images of the gauge-invariant local observables for which decay is controlled form a linear subspace dense in Omega-perp.

For that same dense observable class, prove one common physical-unit exponent Delta > 0 controlling every diagonal translated correlation, rather than vector-dependent exponents whose infimum may vanish.
Combine reconstruction, observable completeness, and the common decay estimate with YM-D005-L001 to discharge YM-D005 for the same four-dimensional limiting theory.

cross_debt_dependencies.effect: Blocks R002 reconstruction until the complete OS profile and reconstruction hypotheses are proved for one limiting hierarchy.
The reconstructed hierarchy must arise from a nontrivial four-dimensional continuum theory along a controlled physical trajectory.
The gauge-invariant local observable family and its ultraviolet normalization must be identified in the same limiting theory.
Any regulated spectral information used to establish the common physical decay scale must survive the regulator limit with spectral stability.

false_proof_firewalls: A single fast-decaying correlator does not imply the bottom of the full non-vacuum spectrum.
A dense class with positive but vector-dependent rates does not imply a positive global gap.
The abstract spectral theorem does not supply Osterwalder-Schrader reconstruction, continuum existence, observable density, or the common physical decay estimate.
current_frontier: YM-D005-R002 is not presently executable as a Yang-Mills theorem because its reconstructed four-dimensional limiting theory is itself blocked by YM-D002 and YM-D003; future work must close those dependencies or select another authorized D001-D004 restricted target.
certification_boundary: No node in this DAG is a MATHCERT certificate. YM-D005-L001 is admitted in Solve only; YM-D005 and YM-001 remain open.
